# Whip Pan

**Motion › Whip** · v1.0.0 · 16 frames at 30 fps (8–30)

A very fast pan with heavy motion blur that hides the cut, as if the camera whipped to the next scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/whip-pan@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Energetic scene changes
- Travel and action edits
- Joining two handheld shots

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import whipPan from './transitions/05-motion/whip/whip-pan';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(whipPan, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 16 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | enum | `"left"` | `left` · `right` · `up` · `down` | Direction the motion travels. |
| `blur` | number | `90` | 0–200 | Peak motion blur in pixels. |
